visual_scene_plan.purpose: Click-through anchors for the converted wet/dry registry annex, ordinary mandate work, source and translation divergence, immediate safety authority, final public record, and four disposition families.
visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Give the room, routine, preparation, mandate arrival, pivotal translation divergence, departure alert, emergency hold, final record, and each ending family a stable visual scene. Branch-specific actions modify the preparation, divergence, and safety frames instead of inventing new room geometry.
visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Every base prompt describes a complete visible frame in plain language with room geometry, camera, light, materials, interfaces, body plans, clothing, props, and stance. Modifiers add only the visible state delta. Character references are assembled only for characters listed as visible in the rendered frame.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Style: retro-industrial hard-science-fiction editorial illustration, precise ink linework under opaque gouache, slate-blue water, sodium amber and cold white task light, tactile worn steel and ceramic, readable body silhouettes and interfaces, restrained expression, bleak corporate procedure with humane workplace warmth, square illustrated interactive-fiction frame.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble each render from global_style_cue, the scene base_image_prompt, visual refs for named characters actually listed in visible_characters, and triggered state_image_modifiers or global_branch_image_modifiers. Use a camera-specific blockout from scene_set for multi-angle website rendering.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide view from the dry entrance of Registry Annex B inside a Ganymede orbital dock in 2478. A long rectangular dispatch bay is divided lengthwise by a waist-high sealed pressure wall. Portside, a deep slate-blue orientation basin runs beneath thick windows showing dock trusses, tethered cargo hulls, Jupiter's banded curve, and black space. Dryside, a worn clerk bench holds a ceramic duplicate press, covered tea cup in a clamp, source receiver, pale translation panel, red-rimmed safety square, and raised tactile pins. A broad route board bridges basin and bench with white route lines, low acoustic emitter discs, and visible water ripples. Talu-at-Four-Returns, an uplifted slate-blue dolphin with a pale jaw and three short white scars near the dorsal fin, surfaces beside the wall. Sen Ochoa, a compact brown-skinned human recorder with shaved dark hair, orange union vest, gray work shirt, magnetic-soled boots, and wrist stylus, stands at the bench. Rem Saye, a tall dark-skinned human dispatcher in a navy Lightsail coat, and Vela Quine, a pale human bond clerk with cropped silver hair and a charcoal office jacket, wait beside separate dryside stations.
